reviewer: showcase-gemini (bead 9e0 — revert-rule component reset and contrast fix)

spec_match.rationale: Accurately models CSS Cascade Level 5 revert-rule semantics: demonstrates rolling back specific properties to the previous matching rule in the author origin, while contrasting with revert (UA origin) and initial (spec defaults).

interactive.rationale: Cards are selectable and keyboard-navigable with aria-pressed state; live computed style table reads back element properties; submit buttons trigger visual confirmation; inputs and selects are editable with real options.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Concept lede matches the feature-index promise on key terms (author, initial, only, revert, rule, styles, unmodified, cascade).

edge_cases.rationale: Side-by-side comparison covers all four reset behaviors (no reset, revert-rule, revert, initial) with truthful cascade origin explanations.

references.rationale: Dedicated references section linking ChromeStatus, CSS Cascade Level 5 revert-rule, and MDN.

design_system.rationale: Resolved 1:1 contrast defect on Chrome 148 badge (now #064e3b on #e6f6ee = 8.69:1 AAA), primary button in accent theme (now #ffffff on #1e40af = 8.72:1 AAA), and input contrast (now 9.52:1 AAA). Button hover rules pair background and color.

accessibility.rationale: All interactive buttons and inputs meet 44px min-height tap targets, aria-pressed states on cards, and aria-live polite regions on explanations.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified in Chrome DevTools MCP at mobile 360x740 DPR3 (0px overflow) and desktop 1280x800.

summary: component-reset-demo updated (bead 9e0): corrected revert-rule previous-rule cascade narration and computed table read-back, made cards selectable with live explanation and feedback toasts, elevated Chrome 148 badge contrast to 8.69:1 AAA, primary button to 8.72:1 AAA, and input contrast to 9.52:1 AAA, and verified 0px mobile overflow at 360px viewport.

guidanceConsulted.query: high contrast status badge and input text contrast
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Ensure text against background meets at least 4.5:1 for normal text and 7:1 for enhanced contrast.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied. Fixed 1:1 green badge with #e6f6ee/#064e3b (8.69:1), primary button with #ffffff/#1e40af (8.72:1), and input with #eff6ff/#1e3a8a (9.52:1).
guidanceConsulted.evidence: DevTools MCP computed styles evaluation confirmed WCAG AAA compliance.
